context: Evaluates whether broad product planning is partitioned into reviewable executable plans while preserving cross-cutting privacy, persistence, and lifecycle contracts.

checklist.name: settings-ownership
checklist.description: The plan keeps durable app-wide choices in Settings, task-specific choices in their owning feature, and authorization or delivery policy in system Settings or Health.

checklist.name: global-preferences
checklist.description: The plan preserves exact defaults, persistence, migration, sync, rollback, and active-workout refresh behavior for global preferences without inventing generic Settings infrastructure.

checklist.name: privacy-contract
checklist.description: Widget personal details are removed before App Group encoding, payload tests inspect the encoded snapshot, and system privacy redaction remains an independent second layer.

checklist.name: health-clear-contract
checklist.description: Imported Health clearing drains observer and backfill work, advances a checked writer generation, clears atomically while preserving app-owned facts and integration state, then reconciles readers before deliberate resumption.

checklist.name: contextual-preferences
checklist.description: Command favorites, measurement pins, plan-occurrence rest, and scene-lifetime browsing state remain with their owning features and retain the fixture's persistence boundaries.

checklist.name: plan-partitioning
checklist.description: Independently approvable subsystems are split into compact executable plans with a short dependency index, while genuinely cross-cutting constraints are stated once.

checklist.name: verification-layers
checklist.description: The plans attach focused proof to each slice and keep build, simulator, accessibility, physical-device, migration, and external-system evidence distinct.

checklist.name: plan-density
checklist.description: The artifacts are clear outcome-focused handoffs, avoid a duplicated Current State, Target Standard, Scope, Contracts, Context Checked, and Deferrals report, and include repository facts only where they constrain implementation.

checklist.name: planning-boundary
checklist.description: The worker does not implement source and does not create a mandatory review or changelog that restates the executable plans.
